Name: Clover Island
Author: ejc5million
Description:
This farm includes the Home island, Main island, And Forest Island.
The Home island is where your house, mailbox, shipping bin, pet and spouse area are located
The main island is separated into 2 parts, one part is where most of your farming will take place, it has some open areas of dirt and access to the greenhouse, The other part is a Beach, it allows Beach forage and crates to spawn there, which can give you some nice resources early game.
The last island is the Forest island which includes Regenerating stumps, Seasonal forage, and access to the farm cave.
The ocean lets you catch beach fish and crab pots work like in the ocean.

[left][/left][center]﻿[/center][size=4][u]Things to know[/u]
You don't get any TV in the beginning thanks to a SDV bug :(
You can buy one at robins or just spawn one in
The farm cave is located in the forest area off to the right.
